title: Bhunay Naryal wali Murghi (Chicken with Roasted Coconut)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: A South Indian-style curry inspired by the author's friend Robin Varghese from Kerala; a departure from the usual Pakistani and North Indian chicken.

steps.action: Dry-roast in a large frying pan on medium (5/10), stirring often, 10+ min, until the coconut is medium brown:
Blend right away into a smooth paste, adding water ¼ cup (60 ml) at a time if too thick:
Heat in a large pot on medium-high (7/10), 3 min:
Add and fry, stirring often, 5 to 10 min, until it starts to brown:
items: 1 medium onion (8 oz / 225 g), chopped, not too fine
8 fresh curry leaves or a handful dried (optional)

steps.action: Add and stir until no pink remains:
items: 1¾ lb boneless chicken thighs (800 g; breasts ok), in 1 in (2.5 cm) cubes

steps.action: Add, stir, and bring to a boil over high:
Stir in; turn off heat, cover, and rest 5 min:
